automations.title: Bol.com — Sync All Price Targets
automations.summary: Push every BOL price_targets row to Bol Partner Portal.
automations.description: Reads all BOL.COM rows from Supabase price_targets, resolves offer UIDs, and sets tijdelijke prijs + date range on partner.bol.com for each product. Use this after updating target prices in Supabase.

automations.title: Bol.com — Single Price Update
automations.summary: Set or remove one Bol promotional price.
automations.description: Sets or removes tijdelijke prijs on a single Bol offer. Pass EAN, offer_uid, price and dates in actions[0]. For bulk sync use Bol Sync All instead.

automations.title: Amazon — Sync All Price Targets
automations.summary: Still being built — mapping and scripts not on GitHub yet.
automations.description: Loops amz-price-update.js across UK, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, BE, USA and CA until price_targets_ready is empty. Use after updating Amazon targets in Supabase.

automations.title: Amazon — Single Price Update
automations.summary: Still being built — run locally only until Amazon pricing is verified.
automations.description: Navigates Seller Central inventory, sets sale price for one ASIN/channel. Pass params in actions[0]. For bulk use Amazon Sync All.

automations.title: Listing Monitor — Price & Buy Box Scrape
automations.summary: Scrape all Puzzlup prices across 11 sales channels.
automations.description: Scrapes ~73 product variants on 10 Amazon markets (Playwright), Bol.com and puzzlup.be. Updates amazon_monitor_fba_puzzlup, listing content, margins and pricing adjustments.

automations.title: Flieber — Sync Forecasts
automations.summary: Push Puzzlup sales forecasts to Flieber.
automations.description: Updates Flieber forecast grid for all 5 stores (~481 data points). Executor auto-chains forecast-verify when complete.

automations.title: Flieber — Verify Forecasts
automations.summary: Verify forecast upload after sync.
automations.description: Checks Flieber UI that forecast values match expected data. Usually triggered automatically after forecast-sync.

automations.title: Flieber — Inventory Forecast Sync
automations.summary: Pull inventory forecast grid from Flieber to Supabase.
automations.description: Scrapes Flieber inventory forecast (stock, days of stock, stockout dates, replenishment needs) into flieber_inventory_forecast table.

automations.title: Flieber — PO Simulation
automations.summary: Create a new Purchase Order simulation in Flieber.
automations.description: Runs PO simulation (arrival +120d, coverage 120d) via Flieber GraphQL. Returns simulation ID and product suggestions.

automations.title: Flieber — TO Simulation
automations.summary: Create a new Transfer Order simulation in Flieber.
automations.description: Runs TO simulation (departure +7wd, arrival +17wd, coverage 70d) via Flieber GraphQL. Returns simulation ID and product suggestions.

automations.title: Inventory — Kamps / Corax EU
automations.summary: Sync EU 3PL stock from Kamps/Corax WMS.
automations.description: Scrapes Vanthiel Corax WMS and writes on-hand + in-transit to Inventory_Levels. Microsoft SSO — MFA may be required.

automations.title: Inventory — Mintsoft UK
automations.summary: Sync UK 3PL stock from Mintsoft.
automations.description: Scrapes Mintsoft (WePrepFBA) portal and updates Inventory_Levels for UK warehouse.

automations.title: Inventory — Forceget CA + US
automations.summary: Sync North America 3PL inventory from Forceget.
automations.description: Logs into Forceget portal and syncs CA + US warehouse stock to Inventory_Levels. Executor injects browser context.

automations.title: Inventory — Forceget (legacy task type)
automations.summary: Alias for Forceget inventory sync.
automations.description: Same script as inventory-sync-forceget. Kept for backward compatibility with older agent tasks.

automations.title: Inventory — Kamps discovery export
automations.summary: Legacy Kamps inventory scrape.
automations.description: Standalone Kamps/Corax inventory export. Prefer inventory-sync-kamps for production Inventory_Levels sync.

automations.title: Inventory — Mintsoft discovery export
automations.summary: Legacy Mintsoft inventory scrape.
automations.description: Standalone Mintsoft export. Prefer inventory-sync-mintsoft for production sync.

automations.title: Inventory — GLC warehouse
automations.summary: Scrape GLC WMS inventory.
automations.description: Exports stock levels from GLC warehouse portal to JSON / Inventory_Levels pipeline.

automations.title: Inventory — Forceget legacy export
automations.summary: Legacy Forceget inventory script.
automations.description: Older Forceget inventory export. Prefer inventory-sync-forceget for production.

automations.title: Inventory — Multi-warehouse sync
automations.summary: Orchestrate multiple inventory sources.
automations.description: Legacy orchestrator for inventory sync across warehouses.

automations.title: Sellerboard — P&L Export
automations.summary: Export P&L and per-ASIN reports from Sellerboard.
automations.description: Downloads main P&L and per-ASIN CSV/JSON for EU and NA Amazon marketplaces from Sellerboard.

automations.title: Mintsoft — Product Export
automations.summary: Export all Mintsoft products and stock.
automations.description: Exports SKU, name, carton sizes, weight and per-warehouse inventory from Mintsoft WMS.

automations.title: Forceget — Live Inventory Export
automations.summary: Export live Toronto warehouse inventory.
automations.description: Scrapes Forceget for SKU, ASIN, on-hand, allocated and available units.

automations.title: Corax — Stock Export
automations.summary: Export raw stock per article from Corax WMS.
automations.description: Scrapes Vanthiel Corax WMS stock levels per artikel. Returns JSON in task result.

automations.title: Bol.com — Customer Cases Scraper
automations.summary: Scrape open Bol partner cases for customer service.
automations.description: Logs into partner.bol.com, scrapes open/new customer cases with full email bodies for CS agent processing.
